derivation: rebuilt from original PostgreSQL monitor samples, Scylla proc samples, host disk observer samples and case/runner result files

formulas.cgroup_io: 8:16 io.stat boundary counter delta; wbytes is container write bytes
formulas.database_cpu: cgroup usage_usec delta between nearest sample at/before window start and nearest sample at/after window end, divided by bracket duration and two assigned database CPUs, multiplied by 100
formulas.database_memory: maximum cgroup memory.current at samples inside measured window; MiB = bytes / 1024^2
formulas.host_diskstats: nearest host samples bracketing request window; rates use host-sample interval and diskstats sectors * 512; MiB = bytes / 1024^2
formulas.post_window_checkpoint: PostgreSQL checkpoint and cgroup write bytes are after the measured request window, outside RPS and in-window resource metrics
formulas.postgres_pss: maximum summed PostgreSQL process PSS in-window; MiB = KB / 1024; backend RSS is not summed
formulas.postgres_swap_oom: maximum sampled memory.swap.current and ending memory.events counters
formulas.wal_vs_commitlog: PostgreSQL WAL/fsync and Scylla commitlog counters have different semantics and are not compared one-to-one or treated as request counts
formulas.whole_vs_partition: whole device 8:16 and data partition 8:18 are alternate views; never add their counters
formulas.window: request window uses exact client start/end Unix-ns timestamps; samples carry their offset and inside/before/after relation
